name: BRAND TEXT
description: Pro Health Sauna’s started in 2002, since then we have become Canada’s #1 Sauna Dealer coast to coast. Our business is built on customer service and building the best infrared saunas for our customers. We get many testimonials and referrals from hundreds of satisfied customers. We deal with each customer on a personal basis our goal is to get you the best sauna for the best price. We want you to be totally satisfied with your purchase and we will be glad to talk to you about any questions you have at any time. At Pro Health Saunas we want you to be well informed so you can make your own decision and we are glad to help you along the way, even if you choose not to buy a sauna from us.
